title: Transport connection versus synchronized Wire view
summary: Browser readiness is staged. The recovery line replaces the misleading rule that a connected WebSocket is immediately 'Live' with explicit Connecting, Transport connected, Receiving view and View ready states, plus synchronization/resynchronization/disconnected states.
invariants: HTTP 101/WebSocket open means transport connected only.
View ready requires authoritative Wire state to have been received and applied.
Empty/failed semantic projection must not be hidden behind a green Live indicator.
Readiness display is diagnostic presentation; server revisions and authoritative state remain the truth.

provenance.claim: Development/recovery evidence; does not supersede the accepted v0.11 executable baseline.
